= empty-quote-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Empty formatting
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-01
:blank:
:markup: *introduced*

== NAME

empty-quote-subs - quote and attribute substitution order

== DESCRIPTION

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S01 Before *{blank}* and **{blank}** after.

[subs="attributes,quotes"]
S02 Before *{blank}* and **{blank}** after.

[subs="quotes"]
S03 Before *{blank}* after.

[subs="attributes"]
S04 Before *{blank}* after.

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S05 Before *_{blank}_* and [.role]*{blank}* after.

[subs="attributes,quotes"]
S06 Before {markup} after.

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S07 Before {markup} after.

[listing,subs="quotes,attributes,macros"]
----
S08 Before *{blank}* and _{blank}_ after.
----

[listing,subs="attributes,quotes,macros"]
----
S09 Before *{blank}* and _{blank}_ after.
----

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S10 Before "`{blank}`" and '`{blank}`' after.
